description: Test suite for store operations related to boards and blocks in the focalboard project, including creation, patching, deletion, and duplication of boards and blocks.

methods.name: StoreTestBoardsAndBlocksStore
methods.description: Runs subtests for creating, patching, deleting, and duplicating boards and blocks in the store.

methods.name: testCreateBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests creation of boards and blocks, including success, failure, and size limit scenarios.

methods.name: testPatchBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests patching of boards and blocks, including success, failure, and size limit scenarios.

methods.name: testDeleteBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests deletion of boards and blocks, including various error conditions and successful deletion.

methods.name: testDuplicateBoard
methods.description: Tests duplication of existing boards as templates or non-templates, and handling of non-existing boards.
